name: Toba (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Toba city emblem in red: a winged ring with a small point at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Toba, a city in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Toba city emblem — a winged ring with a small point at the top
